name: Mojito Tarantula | 1g
description:
Mint, lime, and a slight herbal bite. Hybrid profile keeps you functional and present — this is a conversation-and-chill strain. The mint terpenes add a cooling sensation that stands out. Refreshing.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
